minor.issue: download_url derived from request.base_url resolves to internal ingress host (http://mailscanner-pro.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud/...) rather than the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Works, but exposes internal hostname and downgrades scheme to http. Consider reading a configured PUBLIC_BASE_URL from env or using X-Forwarded-Proto/Host headers.

test_version_manifest_put_and_upgrade_flow expects new_version=1.2.0 but DB current_version was already 1.3.0 from iteration 2. Not a bug in iteration 3 code, but the test is order-sensitive; consider seeding version state at fixture setup.

issues: Success card is small and vertically centered creating very large empty area above/below at 1920x4000 viewport. Consider constraining container height or adding hero header/logo above the card.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/PUBLIC_BASE_URL env for install-info download_url so the wget one-liner uses https:// preview host instead of internal cluster hostname.
(Optional) Make test_version_manifest_put_and_upgrade_flow idempotent by resetting current_version in a fixture.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2453 lines — modular split (checkout/, analytics/, plugin/, licensing/, i18n/) is overdue.
/api/plugin/download rebuilds tar.gz from disk on every request. For seller with many downloads this is wasteful; cache the tar.gz per version in memory or on disk keyed by version+mtime.
/api/analytics/mrr trend uses `now.replace(day=1) - timedelta(days=i*30)` which is not calendar-month accurate — months with 31 days will drift. Use relativedelta for monthly buckets.

/api/checkout/webhook returns {received:false} 200 on invalid signature — good (no crash) but Stripe recommends returning 400 to signal invalid signatures so Stripe will retry. Consider 400 for auth failures, 200 only for handled events.
CheckoutSuccess page (/checkout/success) fetches license and one-liner inline; no error state visible for pending/expired session_id — user just sees blank card. Add loading/error UX.
